https://www.patreon.com/c/u28552796/collections
It is among the paid patreon collection which requires you to become a member. But it is only about 3.5 dollars a month. So it is not too expansive. I don't know if you need animated sprites in particular, but I am using these for enemies in my game, you just need Visustella battle core (for MZ users). I did supply an image of what the dwarves look like in my game. There are also other free sprites. As these are paid assets, I can't link the sprites directly for obvious reasons.
Also, here is a link to the store page for the dwarf tileset:
Also, this blog here has various walking sprites, including dwarves:
https://spritespace.blogspot.com/2013/10/to-start-of-with-here-are-collection-of.html
For static dwarf battlers, I did find these:
http://yanfly.moe/2017/10/02/librarium-extra-dwarves-i/
Just remember to credit the people responsible for making the assets in the games credits.
